description: "Fort Lafayette or, Love and Secession: A Novel" by Benjamin Wood is a historical fiction novel written during the early 1860s, amidst the backdrop of the Civil War era in the United States. This narrative introduces us to intriguing characters navigating the complexities of love, rivalry, and the stark realities of a nation on the brink of division.
